Padhne wala edition (Hinglish)

AI From Zero

Pune ki ek chhoti si team ne ek privacy guard banaya, aur seekha ki AI products asal mein kaise bante hain

Yeh kitaab padhne ke liye hai, course karne ke liye nahi. Wahi ideas, wahi kram, wahi shabd jo course app mein hain, bas ek lambi kahani ki tarah.

Padhna shuru kariyeWahin se jaari rakhiye

47 chapterlagbhag 90 hazaar shabd236 shabd samjhaaye gaye

Vishay-soochi

  1. Shuru karne se pehleYeh kitaab kya sikhati hai, kaise baanti gayi hai, aur kis company aur kin logon ka project poori kitaab mein chalta hai.
1

Woh problem jo hal karne layak hai

Anaya ko chat mein kuch ajeeb dikhta hai, aur woh seekhti hai ki product wala insaan kaise tay karta hai ki kya banana hai aur kya chhod dena hai.

  1. 1Chat Mein Woh NumberEk product manager ko ek hafte ki customer chats mein pehchaan ke numbers milte hain, aur use tay karna hai ki is khoj par ek saal ka kaam banta hai ya nahi. Chapter mein personal data, faisle se pehle ginti, problems ke beech chunaav aur likhe hue decision ki baat hoti hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 2Banane Se Pehle Chaar SawaalEk engineer ek achhe lagte idea ko un chaar tareekon par parakhta hai jinse products fail hote hain. Example ek aisa feature hai jise kisi ne dhoondha hi nahi. Aap product banane ke teen stages, chaar product risks, aur logon ko bechne aur companies ko bechne ka farq samjhenge.9 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 3Kal Ke Baare Mein PoochhnaEk colleague se pehli baatcheet mein sirf haan milti hai, aur paanch behtar baatcheeton se saboot milta hai. Aap seekhenge ki logon se unke beete hue kal ke baare mein kaise poochhein, unka asli maksad kaise samjhein, aur woh ek assumption kaise dhoondhein jise sabse pehle test karna hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 4Yahan Aur Kaun Khada HaiCompliance head ki ek shart wali haan tool ke liye ek kadi requirement tay kar deti hai. Uske baad product manager dekhti hai ki pehle se kya maujood hai, market ka size neeche se upar naapti hai, aur competition ko parakhti hai, us competitor ko bhi jo product nahi hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 5Kya Nahi Karna Hai, Yeh ChunnaNau achhe ideas ki list strategy nahi hoti. Ek retired teacher ka sawaal product manager ko strategy likhne tak le jaata hai. Woh ek chhota pehla target aur success ka ek hi number chunti hai, product ka naam rakhti hai, aur kaam ko aise scores se rank karti hai jinhe woh override karne ko taiyaar hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 6Aisa Plan Jis Par Doosre Bharosa KareinStrategy tab tak sirf ek sentence hai jab tak doosre log us par kaam na kar sakein. Aap seekhenge ki dates ke bajaye outcomes ka waada kaise karein, goals ko naapne laayak results mein kaise likhein, kaun "na" keh sakta hai yeh kaise map karein, aur yeh maan kar kaise chalein ki project pehle hi fail ho chuka hai.10 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 7Likh Kar Rakhna Taaki Doosre Bana SakeinEk engineer guard ko ek napkin par banata hai, aur product manager us sketch ko aisi specification mein badalti hai jisse koi ajnabi bana sake. Aap guard ke chaar hisse, requirements aur acceptance criteria, patle pehle versions, aur kaagaz par test se woh baat seekhenge jo meeting nahi dikha sakti.11 min padhai✓ padha
2

Machine se mulaqaat

Language model kya hai, usse baat kaise karte hain, aur kaise pata chalta hai ki usne achha kaam kiya ya nahi.

  1. 8Machine Asal Mein Kya HaiJis product manager ne do saal "powered by AI" kaha hai, woh iska matlab samjhane ki koshish karti hai aur samjha nahi paati. Hum jawaab ko neeche se banate hain: language models, tokens, context window, attention, model kaise banta aur chalta hai, aur do tarah ke AI.9 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 9Pehli BaatcheetEk engineer product manager ko language model ke paas jaati ek request aur wapas aata jawaab dikhata hai. Jawaab ke saath lagi rasid jawaab jitna hi sikha deti hai. Aap API, JSON, API key, usage block, aur yeh seekhenge ki confident jawaab saboot kyun nahi hota.7 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 10Ek Dimaag Jise Kuch Yaad Nahi RehtaLanguage model ek request se doosri request tak kuch yaad nahi rakhta. Chatbot mein jo yaaddasht dikhti hai, woh asal mein application ka poori baatcheet dobara bhej dena hai. Chapter batata hai ki yeh kaise hota hai, ismein kitna kharcha aata hai, aur yeh project ki sabse badi privacy problem ko kaise badal deta hai.6 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 11Instructions DenaTeam pehli baar language model se guard ka kaam karwati hai, aur use teen alag tareekon se fail hote dekhti hai. Chapter mein prompt, system prompt, temperature, hallucination aur worked example aate hain. Saath mein yeh farq bhi ki instruction failure ko kam kar deta hai, lekin uski wajah ko khatam nahi karta.8 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 12Kaise Pata Chale Ki Yeh Kaam Karta HaiTeam ab yeh dekhna band kar deti hai ki jawaab kaisa "lagta" hai. Woh tool ka jawaab dekhne se pehle sahi jawaab likh leti hai. Chapter mein test set, answer key, scoreboard, ek baar mein ek hi cheez badalna, aur request ke 5 tarah ke kaam aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 13Chhaantna Aur Summary LikhnaEk kaam ka sahi jawaab hota hai, aur ek ka nahi. Team ek sorter ko naapti hai aur ek aisi failure pakadti hai jo ek single score chhupa raha tha. Phir ek summary ko check karti hai ki usne kaun se facts chhod diye. Chapter mein classifier, har tarah ki galti ki keemat, aur must-keep list aate hain.7 min padhai✓ padha
3

Cheezein dhoondhna, aur poori machine

Lambe documents, shabdon se aur matlab se search, aur kaise saare hisse milkar ek chalta hua system banate hain.

  1. 14Ek Baar Mein Padhne Ke Liye Bahut LambaChatbot Sahaj ke apne documents se jawaab kaise deta hai, yeh samajhne ke liye ek product manager ek policy ko kainchi se teen baar kaatti hai. Chapter batata hai ki documents ko todna kyun padta hai, chunking kya hoti hai, aur kaatne ka koi ek tareeka sahi kyun nahi hota.7 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 15Words Se DhoondhnaEk product manager search box ka role nibhati hai. Use pata chalta hai ki text dhoondhne ka sabse purana tareeka un customers ko kyun fail karta hai jinhe sabse zyada madad chahiye, aur identity number ke liye woh bilkul sahi kyun hai. Chapter mein keyword search aur uski chupchaap failure aati hai.6 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 16Matlab Se DhoondhnaEk bazaar jahan ek hi dhandhe ki dukaanein ek gali mein hoti hain, product manager ko wahi tasveer deta hai jo use us idea ke liye chahiye jisne search ko bachaya, aur ek aise number ke liye bhi jis par shak karna chahiye. Chapter mein embeddings aur similarity scores aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 17Kitna Achha Hai AchhaEk founder woh sawaal poochhta hai jo har AI project ko kabhi na kabhi sunna padta hai. Jawaab nikalta hai do numbers, unke beech ek choice jo engineer ka kaam nahi hai, aur ek figure jo Anaya ne bina check kiye bol diya tha. Chapter mein recall aur precision aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 18Poori MachineChatbot ka har hissa ab haath se banaya aur toda ja chuka hai, isliye poori machine yaad se banayi ja sakti hai aur use ek naam diya ja sakta hai. Chapter mein retrieval-augmented generation, uske chupchaap fail hone ke tareeke, aur customer ke words ke safar ki jagahein aati hain.7 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 19Aise Jawaab Jo Program Istemaal Kar SakeEk paragraph insaan ke liye theek hai aur program ke kisi kaam ka nahi. Is chapter mein aap dekhenge ki JSON ke liye pyaar se kehna kaafi kyun nahi, schema galtiyon ki ek poori family kaise hata deta hai, sahi shape mein bhi galat cheez kyun aa sakti hai, aur aisa form kaise banate hain jisme invent karne ki jagah hi na ho.7 min padhai✓ padha
4

Machine ko kaam dena

Tools, sochne wale models, dushman text, hazaaron jawaabon ki grading, aur sab kuch kitne mein padta hai.

  1. 20Machine Ko Haath Dena12 digits ka order number bilkul Aadhaar number jaisa dikhta hai, aur dono mein farq karne ka ek hi tareeka hai, use look up karna. Is chapter mein tool calling, tool descriptions, AI agents aur step limits aate hain, dikhta hai ki ek loop ki cost kaise badhti hai, aur woh actions alag kiye jaate hain jo padhte hain aur woh jo kuch karte hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 21Lambi Windows, Sambhal Kar Bhare KamreEk vendor ka daava hai ki bahut bada context window retrieval ki zaroorat hi khatam kar deta hai, aur ek product manager do sawaal poochhti hai jinse meeting wahin khatam ho jaati hai. Chapter dikhata hai ki request mein kitna fit hota hai us se zyada zaroori hai ki usme kya jaata hai, aur context engineering, token budget, caching aur compaction samjhata hai.7 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 22Pehle Sochne Wali MachinesJo model jawaab dene se pehle uska hisaab khud likh leta hai, woh mushkil cases sahi karta hai, lekin uske liye 11 second leta hai. Is chapter mein reasoning models, thinking ki cost, latency, streaming, aur ek aisa design hai jisme mehnga judgement kabhi kisi customer ko intezaar nahi karwata.7 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 23Search Ko Behtar BananaEk customer ko pichhle saal ki late fee bata di jaati hai. Search ke chaar sudhaar ek hi answer key par naape jaate hain, aur sabse kam chamak wala sudhaar hi akela hai jo result ka vaada kar sakta hai. Chapter mein hybrid search, reranking, contextual retrieval, metadata filtering aur agentic search aate hain.7 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 24Jab Page Hukm Dene LageGuard ka kaam hi un logon ka likha padhna hai jinhe hum jaante nahi, isliye woh building ka sabse khula hua program hai. Team ek model ko ek ajnabi ki baat maante dekhti hai, aur seekhti hai ki ek defence jo chance kam karta hai aur ek defence jo power hata deta hai, dono mein kya farq hai. Is chapter mein prompt injection aur lethal trifecta aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 25Hazaar Jawaabon Ko Marks DenaHaath se check karna lagbhag 50 jawaabon ke baad kaam karna band kar deta hai. Is chapter mein jawaab ko marks dene ke teen tareeke hain, aisi model ko test karna jo doosri models ko grade karti hai, aur error analysis, jo is field ka sabse kaam ka quality kaam hai aur jisme kisi machine ki zaroorat nahi.8 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 26Asal Mein Kitna Kharch Hota Hai"Tokens par depend karta hai" finance director ke liye jawaab nahi hai. Ek product manager guard ki sahi keemat nikaalti hai, ek hi tool ke teen bilkul alag totals paati hai, aur dekhti hai ki guard ke hisse kis order mein chalte hain, yeh sabse sasta design decision hai. Is chapter mein cascade aata hai.8 min padhai✓ padha
5

Asli duniya ki uljhanein

Scans aur photos, kya bhejna theek hai, niyam, badalte rehne wali cheez ki spec, aur galat jawaab ke liye design.

  1. 27Kaagaz, Photos Aur ScansAb tak guard ne jo bhi sentence padha, woh pehle se text tha. 50 attachments ka ek random sample dikhata hai ki asli traffic mein aisa kitni kam baar hota hai, aur zero ki jagah capital O ek number ko rule ke saamne se kaise nikaal sakta hai. Is chapter mein OCR aur document audit aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 28Aap Kya Bhej Sakte HainAb tak hum maan kar chal rahe the ki text vendor ko bheja ja sakta hai. Teen documents aur teen sawaal, ek tay order mein, batate hain ki bheja ja sakta hai ya nahi. Aur vendor ki terms of service mein woh baatein nikalti hain jo kisi ne padhi hi nahi thi. Is chapter mein retention aur data residency samjhenge.8 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 29Rules, Risk Aur ZimmedaariLakshmi batati hai ki bank mein bees saal kaam karke usne paperwork ke baare mein kya seekha. Phir team ek page ka document likhti hai: guard kis kaam ke liye hai, kahan galat hota hai, aur use kis kaam mein kabhi nahi lena chahiye. Uske baad woh ek customer ko delete karne ki koshish karte hain aur dekhte hain ki uska data kahan-kahan rehta hai. Chapter mein risk tiers, India ka data protection law, system cards, deletion drills, human oversight aur shadow AI aate hain.10 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 30Badalti Rehne Wali Cheez Ki SpecEk model ke retire hone ka tees din ka notice dikhata hai ki aise software ki specification mein kya hona chahiye jo do baar ek jaisa behave nahi karta. Yeh bhi dikhata hai ki AI band karne wale switch ko kya chalta rehne dena chahiye. Chapter mein rollback, kill switch aur pinned versions samjhenge.9 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 31Banao, Kharido Ya SikhaoEk vendor team ko woh bechne aaya jo team ne chhe mahine mein khud banaya hai, aur ek founder ne suggest kiya ki apna model hi train kar lo. Dono idea samajhdaar lagte hain, aur dono ko ek hi test paas karna hai. Chapter mein AI value chain, open-weight models, fine-tuning aur lock-in samjhenge.9 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 32Galat Jawaab Ke Liye Design90 percent accuracy par das mein se ek jawaab galat hota hai, aur us jawaab par screen kya karti hai, yahi tay karta hai ki log tool par bharosa karenge ya nahi. Phir ek pilot, jo fail hone ke liye bhi design kiya gaya tha, ek ajeeb result deta hai: system kaam karta hai aur kuch badalta nahi. Chapter mein refusals, pilots aur failure thresholds aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
6

Bonnet ke neeche

Plumbing, model chunna, review mein tikne wala retrieval, agents, awaaz aur tasveerein, release gates, aur sabse bura maan kar chalna.

  1. 33Jaadu Ke Neeche Ki PlumbingDo ghante ka ek outage, jisme kisi ne error nahi diya, ek product manager ko yakeen dilata hai ki use us ek anpredictable hisse ke aas-paas ka aam software plumber ke diagram ke level par samajhna chahiye. Chapter mein data contracts, Python, HTTP aur status codes, environment variables, Git aur experiment runners aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 34Apne Cases Par Model ChunnaEk founder us model par switch karna chahta hai jo pichhle hafte ke chart mein sabse upar tha. Team wahi karti hai jo aap gaadi ke saath karte hain: teen models ko apni sadakon par chala kar dekhti hai, faisla ek card par likhti hai, aur phir tay karti hai ki har model ko exactly kya dikhega. Chapter mein leaderboards, routing, model selection cards aur provenance aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 35Review Mein Tikne Wala RetrievalPrototype isliye chalta hai kyunki aapne har document khud chuna hai aur aap hi uske akele user hain. Production dono aaraam cheen leta hai. Ek aisi review mein, jisme baithe log chahte hain ki chatbot fail ho, retrieval system ke chaar sawaal lagaye jaate hain. Chapter mein ingestion, parsers, access control aur abstention aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 36Workflows, Agents Aur Standard PlugBank ka teller balance dekh sakta hai, lekin kisi ke kehne par paisa kahin nahi bhej sakta. Support console ke teen sawaal cheezein kaat kar tay hote hain: model ko kitna tay karne dein, use kaise rokein, aur ek standard plug kya vaada karta hai aur kya nahi. Chapter mein tool contracts, idempotency, fixed workflows, bounded agents aur MCP aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 37Pages, Tasveerein Aur AwaazeinRailway timetable ko word-by-word zor se padh dijiye, phir bhi kisi ko nahi pata chalta ki train kab chhootti hai. Team aakhir mein photographs aur voice notes sambhalti hai. Woh woh stage dhoondhti hai jahan matlab pehli baar galat hota hai, aur aisa test banati hai jo sunne ki galti ko sochne ki galti se alag pehchaan sake. Chapter mein multimodal systems, speech-to-text, voice pipelines aur speaker attribution aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 38Gates, Traces Aur RollbacksFriday raat ek instruction mein bina test ke kiya gaya ek edit dikhata hai ki jo badlaav deployment jaisa nahi lagta, use bhi ek gate se kyun guzarna chahiye, aur "yeh aisa kyun kiya?" ka jawaab chaalis second mein kyun milna chahiye. Is chapter mein golden dataset, regression, release gate, observability, trace record, p95 aur canary release aate hain.8 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 39Sabse Bure Ko Maan Kar ChalnaEk compliance report, ek Saturday jab product ko todne ki koshish hui aur inaam mein mithai thi, aur ek table jisme har safeguard ke saath woh test hai jo use saabit karta hai. Model ko behkaya ja sakta hai, isliye uske aas-paas ka system hi bachaav hai. Is chapter mein attack surface, least privilege, red team, audit trail, risk register aur residual risk aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
7

Ek asli product, aur ek naukri

Product ko ship karna, uski keemat tay karna, usse badhana, gina-na, asli users ke saath chalana, aur is kaam ke liye naukri paana.

  1. 40Product Hai, Demo NahiDo logon ke liye achha bana khana abhi restaurant ke menu ka item nahi hai. Festival season se pehle team woh sab list karti hai jo ek chalte prototype aur ek asli service ke beech mein hai, aur har bade decision ke saath likhti hai ki kya hone par woh use palat degi. Chapter mein production delta, graceful degradation, staging, latency budget, architecture decision record aur exit cost aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  2. 41Poori Cheez Ship KarnaDecember mein Anaya un logon ke saamne khadi hoti hai jinhone is idea par shak kiya tha, aur bataati hai ki usne kya banaya, kya toota, kisne use kiya, uska cost kya hai, aur use kya nahi pata. Jin gyarah stages ko usne follow kiya, woh wahi saal hai jo woh abhi jee kar aayi hai. Chapter mein SDK, findings document, failure class aur evidence pack aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  3. 42Kaun Paisa Deta Hai, Aur KitnaEk lender ka technical lead poochta hai ki guard use kitne ka padega. Jawaab teen alag logon, charge karne ke chaar tareekon, aur ek table ki ek aisi row par tikta hai jo zyadatar price lists mein hoti hi nahi. Chapter mein seat, usage, outcome aur hybrid pricing, contribution margin, flywheel aur gross margin aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  4. 43Log Product Kaise Dhoondhte Hain Aur Kyun Tikte HainJis tool ko koi dhoondh hi nahi paata, woh kisi ki hifaazat nahi karta. Paanch developers ko sirf ek README diya jaata hai, stopwatch dikhata hai ki woh kahan chhod dete hain, aur ek spelling checker dikhata hai ki value ka pehla pal kahan aana chahiye. Chapter mein AARRR, activation, time-to-value, Fogg behaviour model, product-led growth, growth loop, network effect, virality aur dark pattern aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  5. 44Jo Maayne Rakhta Hai Use GinnaJab asli log tool use karne lagte hain, toh sawaal "kya yeh kaam karta hai?" se badal kar "woh kya karte hain?" ho jaata hai. Ek privacy product ko iska jawaab bina us cheez ko record kiye dena hota hai jise chhupane ke liye woh bana hai. Phir sample-size ka ek hisaab dikhata hai ki ek jawaan company woh test kyun nahi chala sakti jo woh chahti hai. Chapter mein event taxonomy, tracking plan, cohort, A/B test aur minimum detectable effect aate hain.9 min padhai✓ padha
  6. 45Tools Aur HarnessEk naya engineer poochta hai ki kaun sa tool kis kaam ka hai, aur ek anubhavi engineer brands ki list nahi, slots ki ek drawing se jawaab deta hai. Wahi engineer phir ek weekly report do baar banata hai, ek baar fixed steps se aur ek baar agent se, aur dono ko wahi bees hafte par naapa jaata hai. Chapter mein toolchain, claim audit, harness, project memory, allowlist, verifier, sub-agent, state machine, feature flag, rollback trigger aur incident review aate hain.14 min padhai✓ padha
  7. 46Asli Log, Asli UseDemo tab tak chalta hai jab tak aap dekh rahe hote hain. Product ko tab chalna hota hai jab koi nahi dekh raha, un logon ke liye jinka aap par koi hisaab nahi. Spring mein Anaya guard ko ajnabiyon ke liye taiyaar karti hai, unhe imaandaari se judti hai, bina madad kiye dekhti hai, aur jo dekha uski wajah se ek change ship karti hai. Chapter mein design partner, informed consent, observation session, changelog aur support log aate hain.10 min padhai✓ padha
  8. 47Kaam Aur NaukriEk purani bank analyst ne kuch asli banaya hai aur use dikhana nahi aata. Kuch Sunday shaamon mein Anaya uski madad karti hai ki ek saal ke kaam ko woh teen cheezon mein badle: jin jobs ki use chaah hai unki tasveer, saboot ka ek page, aur un sawaalon ke jawaab dene ka ek rehearse kiya hua tareeka jo tay karte hain ki job milegi ya nahi. Chapter mein role matrix, case study, product sense, system-design interview, STAR method aur take-home aate hain.11 min padhai✓ padha
